OBSERVED: dispatchDirective() returns early for COMPLETED and CANCELLED and conditionally for FAILED, but has no PROCESSING early-return.
An idempotent POST /api/directives replay always calls attemptDirectiveDispatch(existingPipelineRunId) after resolving the accepted run.
If the durable DirectiveDispatch row is PROCESSING, enqueueDirective() sees the existing BullMQ job and can return an ordinary idempotent hit.
dispatchDirective() then unconditionally updates that durable row to ENQUEUED, increments attempts, and clears lastError.
completeDirectiveDispatch() later updates only rows whose status is still PROCESSING.

Therefore an idempotent HTTP replay during active processing can regress PROCESSING -> ENQUEUED and make the worker's later completion update a no-op, leaving a completed BullMQ job projected as ENQUEUED.
EXPECTED: A durable PROCESSING dispatch is already delivered/claimed and must be treated idempotently without re-enqueueing or regressing its state.
Idempotent API replay during active processing must return the same accepted run without mutating PROCESSING back to ENQUEUED.
Durable state progression must be monotonic across ENQUEUED -> PROCESSING -> COMPLETED/CANCELLED/FAILED according to authorized paths.
